analysis:
This PR adds a local-only add-on hold subsystem under ProviderCore/Addon: a unix-socket IPC (AddonIPC/AddonIPCServer), signed-peer policy (AddonPeerPolicy), persisted hold store, machine-lock observer, operator control mailbox types and local telemetry. It adds no coordinator, wire or consumer-data surface. Prompt data (A-001), keys (A-003) and attestation assets are not touched.

Checks done:
- AddonIPCServer: socket bound in a 0700 runtime dir, chmod 0600, uid and code-signature checked per request through LOCAL_PEERTOKEN (audit token with pidversion). Messages are bounded to 8 KiB, 8 connections, idle/write/handler timeouts, and the stale socket is replaced only if owned by this user and not accepting connections. Stop unlinks only the inode it bound.
- AddonPeerPolicy: requires the Developer ID anchor, team ID, identifier and hardened runtime. The dev identity is gated by #if DEBUG.
- AddonHoldStore: O_NOFOLLOW, owner and 0600 check, 64 KiB cap, schema and lease validation, atomic O_EXCL temp write plus rename.
- AddonMachineLock: fails closed (any open error other than ENOENT counts as held).
- AddonHoldControl: target ProcessIdentity binding and a 60 s freshness window.
- Telemetry carries no prompts, IDs or models.

Minor, same-UID-only observations that are not reportable as regressions (the code states same-UID is not a boundary):
- DARKBLOOM_ADDON_SOCKET is not DEBUG-gated (AddonHoldPaths.swift:32). It relocates the runtime dir and machine-lock observation, and prepare() may chmod the chosen parent to 0700.
- Connections are not authenticated at accept (AddonIPCServer.swift:128), so a same-UID process can occupy the 8 slots for up to 300 s.
- A handler may complete after the 30 s timeout has already returned unavailable (AddonIPCServer.swift:203-209).

Open integration questions, since the handler, provider-loop wiring and CLI are not in this batch: whether the handler enforces that the hold addon equals peer.identifier, how control-request replay within the 60 s window is deduplicated, and whether the hold and drain paths cannot be abused to stall serving.
